notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43340896/6be5e3c619c887aa9a5efae12519468385214bbd.png[/img]

[b]v1.0.1 now released![/b]

[list]
[*][b] Chapter map[/b], now you can play any level completed if you want to changue choices and try another ways to the end(instead of starting a new game again).
[*] Increased sprint speed in Delivery Man chapter.
[*] Increased sprint speed and health in Thief of Diamonds chapter.
[/list]

notes.title: Gameplay Reveal
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=phl5tLOGBms;full][/previewyoutube]

In this gameplay video, you can see three different levels showing how can different can be one.

[list]
[*]In the first level you need to deliver three packages with a van. You need to be careful to your hunger, thirst and gas. Exploring the map you can find interesting items to sell and, then buy food, drink, gas cans...
[*]In the second level is more like a fast shooter game, a lot of enemies and different guns that can help you in different situations.
[*]In the third level shown in this gamplay video you need to complete different puzzles. Each puzzle gives you villagers that you can command to gather food, wood or stone. Your objective is to build a boat.
[/list]
